args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Clothing:
- Swimsuits
- Cover-ups
- Light, breathable clothing
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Light jacket or sweater
- Rain jacket or poncho

Toiletries:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher)
- Aloe vera gel
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor
- Hairbrush or comb
- Hair ties
- Makeup and makeup remover
- Skincare products

Accessories:
- Sunglasses
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag or tote
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (if applicable)
- Waterproof phone case

Electronics:
- Phone and charger
- Waterproof camera or GoPro
- Portable power bank
- Waterproof speaker (optional)

Documents and Essentials:
- Passport or ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel or vacation rental reservations
- Flight itinerary
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Travel journal or notebook
- Waterproof bag for documents

Miscellaneous:
- Beach towel
- Waterproof sunscreen bag
- Water shoes (if needed)
- Insect repellent
- Wet wipes or hand sanitizer
- Small first aid kit

Activities and Gear:
- Snorkeling gear (if not already listed)
- Surfboard (if applicable)
- Waterproof hiking shoes
- Waterproof backpack
- Binoculars (for whale watching or birdwatching)
- Waterproof guidebook or map

Health and Safety:
- Prescription medications
- Motion sickness medication (if needed)
- Sea sickness bands
- Band-aids or blister pads
- Hand sanitizer

Note: Adjust this list based on your specific needs and the activities planned for your trip.
